sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dwijendra Prasad Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the parties are present.

In compliance of the order of this Court dated 20.10.2022, the trial court has transmitted the photocopy of the compromise deed dated 15.09.2022 and the verification order passed thereon in the hand writing of the court concerned dated 04.11.2022 alongwith the affidavits of Smt. Parvesh,
opposite party no.2 and Suresh Singh.
Learned counsel for the applicants has placed before the Court the certified copy of the compromise deed and certified copy of the verification order passed thereon alongwith the certified copy of the order sheet dated 04.11.2022.
As the dispute is matrimonial, compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely, hence, the compromise between the parties is accepted.
The certified copy of the compromise deed and the verification order passed thereon alongwith certified copy of the order-sheet dated 04.11.2022 be kept on record.
These documents shall form part of this order.
